summaries.summary: A bar chart titled 'ACTIVE USERS BY SOCIAL PLATFORM' as of January 2014, showing user counts for various platforms. Facebook leads with 1,184 million users, followed by QQ (816 M), QZONE (632 M), WhatsApp (400 M), Google+ (300 M), WeChat (272 M), LinkedIn (259 M), Twitter (232 M), Tumblr (230 M), and Tencent Weibo (220 M). The chart distinguishes between social networks (orange) and messenger/chat apps (red).
key_facts: Facebook has the most active users at 1,184 million.
QQ is second with 816 million users.
The chart categorizes platforms as social networks or messenger/chat apps.
